title: dyssodia neomexicana
intro: Dyssodia neomexicana, commonly known as New Mexico fleabane or Desert Dyssodia, is a perennial plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as soothing digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These compounds have been shown to have potential anti-cancer and anti-diabetic effects, making Dyssodia neomexicana a subject of interest in modern herbal medicine.
